name: linkedin-followup-monorepo
description: LinkedIn job application follow-up automation system

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:setup: psql -c 'CREATE DATABASE linkedin_followup;' && psql linkedin_followup < database-schema.sql
scripts.db:reset: psql -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS linkedin_followup;' && npm run db:setup
